products.name: Lending Services
products.description: The Bank provides a range of lending products including consumer loans, residential mortgages, home equity loans, and commercial loans. These are delivered through physical branches and a loan production office, requiring financial capital, regulatory compliance, and in-person customer service.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: The Bank offers deposit products such as checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts, and treasury management solutions. These are provided via branch offices, digital platforms, and ATMs, requiring regulated infrastructure and digital delivery.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: The Bank provides wealth management services including estate planning, investment management, trustee services, and estate settlement. These services are delivered by specialized personnel and require regulatory compliance and fiduciary expertise.

products.name: Title Insurance Services
products.description: Through its subsidiary, the Bank offers title insurance services, which involve underwriting and issuing title insurance policies, typically requiring specialized legal and insurance expertise.

products.name: Data Services
products.description: Provides broadband Internet access and dedicated data connectivity to residential, business, government, education, and healthcare customers in Alaska, delivered over a network of fiber, microwave, and satellite infrastructure.

products.name: Wireless Services
products.description: Offers mobile voice and data services, including 5G and 4G LTE, to consumers and businesses across Alaska using a statewide wireless network and licensed spectrum.

products.name: Wireline Voice Services
products.description: Delivers local and long-distance telephone services, including VoIP, to residential and business customers over its own facilities and interconnection agreements.

products.name: Managed Services
products.description: Provides managed network services such as WiFi, firewall, detection and response, and network monitoring to business and government clients, leveraging its high-capacity backbone and remote management platform.

products.name: Healthcare Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of real estate properties, including skilled nursing/transitional care facilities, senior housing communities, behavioral health facilities, and specialty hospitals, to third-party operators in the U.S. and Canada. Properties are typically leased under long-term, triple-net leases, with tenants responsible for maintenance and operations.

products.name: Senior Housing Community Management
products.description: Ownership of senior housing communities operated by third-party property managers under property management agreements, where the company receives income based on the performance of the managed communities. These include independent living, assisted living, memory care, and continuing care retirement communities.

products.name: Healthcare Real Estate Financing
products.description: Provision of loans receivable and preferred equity investments secured by healthcare facilities, including mortgage loans and other financing to operators and developers. These investments may include options to purchase the underlying real estate.

products.name: Oral Dabogratinib (FGFR3 Inhibitor)
products.description: An orally administered, highly specific FGFR3-selective small molecule inhibitor developed in-house, delivered as a tablet, designed to treat FGFR3-driven conditions including urothelial cancers (LG-UTUC, IR NMIBC) and skeletal dysplasia (ACH, HCH, Turner syndrome, SHOX deficiency, idiopathic short stature). Manufactured by third-party contract organizations and administered to patients in clinical settings.

products.name: TYRA-430 (FGFR4/3 Inhibitor)
products.description: An investigational, orally administered small molecule inhibitor biased for FGFR4 and FGFR3, designed to target FGF19+/FGFR4-driven cancers such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Manufactured externally and delivered to patients in clinical trials.

products.name: TYRA-200 (FGFR1/2/3 Inhibitor)
products.description: An investigational, orally administered small molecule inhibitor targeting FGFR1/2/3, designed to overcome resistance mutations in FGFR2-driven cancers, initially focused on intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) resistant to prior FGFR inhibitors. Manufactured by third parties and administered in clinical trials.

products.name: Healthcare Information and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Subscription-based and customized data products and analytics services that aggregate, cleanse, and standardize large-scale healthcare data (including medical, hospital, and pharmacy claims, payer remittances, and consumer demographics) to deliver actionable insights for healthcare, life sciences, and pharmaceutical customers. Delivered digitally via a proprietary cloud-based platform, these solutions support operational, clinical, and financial performance optimization.

products.name: Real World Evidence (RWE) and Outcomes Research Solutions
products.description: Project-based and subscription analytics services and databases that integrate disparate healthcare data to enable observational research, near real-time surveillance of adverse events, and evaluation of clinical, economic, and social impacts of therapies. Delivered as reports, dashboards, or analytic platforms to pharmaceutical manufacturers, regulators, and healthcare providers.

products.name: Commercial Analytics and Market Access Solutions
products.description: Data-driven analytics products and services focused on customer segmentation, targeting, campaign measurement, longitudinal patient analytics, and payer market access analytics for life sciences and healthcare companies. Delivered through digital platforms and custom reports to support commercial effectiveness and market strategy.

products.name: Financial Services Healthcare Data Products
products.description: Proprietary healthcare information products and analytics solutions tailored for financial services clients (e.g., hedge funds, mutual funds, pension funds) investing in healthcare, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical sectors. Delivered as data feeds, reports, or analytic tools to inform investment decisions using clinical and commercial healthcare data.

products.name: Technology Platform and Data Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based technology platform and data management services that provide data warehousing, integration, standardization, and delivery of large-scale, de-identified healthcare datasets. Offered as enabling technology to consultants, service providers, and end users to support their own analytics and information product development.

products.name: Residential Consumer Mortgage Loan Aggregation and Securitization
products.description: Acquisition of residential consumer mortgage loans from third-party originators, which are then sold to whole loan buyers, securitized through private-label programs, or transferred to investment portfolios. This involves financial capital, risk management, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Investor Loan Origination and Securitization
products.description: Origination of residential investor loans (term and bridge loans) for single-family rental and multifamily properties, which are then securitized, sold, or transferred to investment portfolios or joint ventures. This requires financial capital, underwriting, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Retained Interests and Investments in Mortgage-Backed Securities
products.description: Investment in and retention of interests from the company’s own securitizations and other investment vehicles, focusing on mortgage-backed securities and related assets. This is managed through financial capital and investment expertise.

products.name: Legacy Loan and Asset Disposition
products.description: Management and disposition of legacy unsecuritized bridge and term loans, re-performing loan securities, and other non-core assets through sale, runoff, or other means. This involves financial management and asset sales.

products.name: Joint Venture Administration and Fee Services
products.description: Administration of joint ventures with institutional investment managers for residential investor bridge and term loans, earning ongoing and performance-based fees. This is a service-based business line requiring financial and administrative expertise.

products.name: Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of potable water through production, purchase, storage, purification, distribution, and retail sale to residential, commercial, and municipal customers. Requires regulated infrastructure, physical assets, and compliance with public utility regulations.

products.name: Wastewater Utility Services
products.description: Collection, treatment, and disposal of wastewater for residential and commercial customers, primarily in Texas and Connecticut. Delivered via regulated infrastructure and subject to public utility regulation.

products.name: Contract Water and Sewer Operations
products.description: Operation and maintenance of water and sewer systems under contract for municipalities and other utilities, including non-tariffed service agreements. Delivered through in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Wholesale Water and Sewer Services
products.description: Sale of water and sewer services to other utilities or entities on a wholesale basis, involving bulk supply and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Service Line and Plumbing Protection Plans
products.description: Provision of protection plans (e.g., Linebacker®) covering repair costs for water and wastewater service lines and in-home plumbing for public drinking water customers. Delivered as a subscription service.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing and Property Management
products.description: Leasing and management of commercial properties and undeveloped land, primarily through subsidiaries. Involves property ownership and leasing activities.

products.name: Low Enriched Uranium (LEU) Supply
products.description: Sale and delivery of low enriched uranium (LEU), including its enrichment component (SWU) and natural uranium hexafluoride, primarily to utilities operating commercial nuclear power plants. LEU is sourced from a global supplier network and delivered under medium- and long-term contracts.

products.name: High-Assay Low Enriched Uranium (HALEU) Production and Supply
products.description: Production and supply of high-assay low enriched uranium (HALEU), enriched up to 20% U235, for advanced nuclear reactors and government customers. HALEU is produced at the Piketon, Ohio facility using proprietary centrifuge technology and delivered under government and commercial contracts.

products.name: Uranium Enrichment Services
products.description: Provision of uranium enrichment services, including both LEU and HALEU enrichment, using advanced centrifuge technology. Services are offered to utilities, government, and private sector customers, supporting both existing and next-generation nuclear reactors.

products.name: Natural Uranium and Uranium Conversion Sales
products.description: Sales of natural uranium hexafluoride, uranium concentrates, and uranium conversion services to utilities and nuclear fuel companies. These are raw materials and conversion steps required for nuclear fuel production, sourced from global suppliers and delivered under contract.

products.name: Advanced Manufacturing and Engineering Services
products.description: Provision of advanced manufacturing, engineering, and technical services, including production of fuel-related components for next-generation nuclear reactors and development of related facilities. Services leverage specialized facilities and technical expertise, and are delivered to government and private sector customers.

products.name: Centrifuge Manufacturing
products.description: Manufacture and supply of advanced centrifuge machines and components, primarily for use in uranium enrichment facilities. Production is based at the Oak Ridge, Tennessee facility and supports both internal enrichment operations and potential external sales.

products.name: Heartflow FFRCT Analysis
products.description: A cloud-based, AI-powered software service that analyzes CCTA images to create a personalized 3D model of a patient's coronary arteries, quantifying blood flow and identifying clinically significant coronary artery disease (CAD) non-invasively. Delivered digitally to physicians for diagnosis and treatment planning, it requires no physical manufacturing and is billed per use.

products.name: Heartflow Plaque Analysis
products.description: An AI-driven software solution that provides automated, comprehensive 3D assessment of coronary plaque type and volume from CCTA images, enabling optimized medical management of CAD. Delivered digitally as an add-on analysis to CCTA, it is billed per use and validated against invasive reference standards.

products.name: Heartflow RoadMap Analysis
products.description: A software feature integrated into the Heartflow Platform that provides intuitive anatomic visualization of coronary anatomy from CCTA images, supporting efficient workflow and consistent identification of stenosis. It is delivered digitally to imaging physicians as part of the platform, not as a stand-alone product, and is used to enhance workflow rather than as a primary revenue driver.

products.name: Heartflow PCI Navigator (expected 2026)
products.description: A forthcoming software feature that will enable pre-PCI assessment of coronary anatomy, lesion-specific physiology, and plaque localization through an interactive 3D model, supporting interventional cardiologists in planning revascularization strategies. It will be delivered digitally as an integrated feature to enhance procedural efficiency, not as a stand-alone product.

products.name: Plaque Tracker (expected 2027)
products.description: A planned software product that will enable longitudinal analysis of sequential CCTAs to measure the efficacy of medical therapy based on plaque regression, delivered digitally as part of the Heartflow Platform.

products.name: Diagnostic Information Services
products.description: Comprehensive laboratory testing services, including routine, non-routine (esoteric), and advanced diagnostics (such as molecular diagnostics, oncology, neurology, genetics, and companion diagnostics), delivered through a national network of laboratories, patient service centers, and digital platforms. Services are provided to physicians, hospitals, patients, and other healthcare organizations, with results accessible via digital portals and integrated with electronic health records.

products.name: Anatomic Pathology Services
products.description: Diagnosis of cancer and other diseases through examination of tissue and cell samples, including traditional and digital pathology, provided via specialized laboratories and expert pathologists. Services are offered under brands such as AmeriPath and Dermpath Diagnostics.

products.name: Consumer-Initiated Testing Services
products.description: Direct-to-consumer laboratory testing services, allowing individuals to order and access health and wellness tests online (e.g., via QuestHealth.com), with options for in-center, at-home, or self-collection, and physician oversight or teleconsultation as needed. Results are delivered digitally, supporting self-directed health management.

products.name: Collaborative Lab Solutions (Hospital Lab Management)
products.description: Outsourced laboratory management and consulting services for hospitals, including lab management, test menu optimization, spend consolidation, supply chain management, and advanced data solutions, enabling hospitals to operate their labs more efficiently or outsource reference testing.

products.name: Workplace Drug Testing and Employer Health Services
products.description: Drug testing (urine, hair, oral fluid) and biometric screening services for employers, including federally-mandated and safety-sensitive testing, as well as population health programs (e.g., Blueprint for Wellness) to improve employee health and reduce healthcare costs. Services are delivered at patient service centers, on-site, or via mobile collection.

products.name: Risk Assessment Services for Insurers (ExamOne)
products.description: Risk assessment and underwriting support services for life insurance companies, including paramedical exams, specimen collection, laboratory testing, and analytics, performed at applicants’ homes, workplaces, or service centers. Also includes health data solutions for clinical research and diagnostics programs.

products.name: Healthcare IT Solutions (Quanum and Analytics)
products.description: Healthcare information technology products and services, including electronic health record connectivity, patient and provider portals (e.g., MyQuest), analytics, and enterprise content management (Quanum), enabling clinicians and organizations to access, analyze, and manage clinical data for improved care and operational efficiency.

products.name: Clinical Trials and Pharma Services
products.description: Laboratory testing, population analytics, patient engagement, and companion/complementary diagnostic development services for pharmaceutical companies and clinical trials, supporting drug development, patient recruitment, and regulatory submissions. Includes Quest Clinical Trials Connect for trial acceleration.

products.name: Population Health and Extended Care Solutions
products.description: Population health management services for clinicians, health plans, and hospitals, leveraging clinical data and analytics to identify gaps in care, provide clinical solutions, and engage patients through home collection kits, mobile phlebotomy, and digital outreach.

products.name: Gasoline and Gasoline Blendstocks
products.description: Sales and distribution of branded and unbranded gasoline and gasoline blendstocks (such as ethanol) to wholesalers, retailers, commercial, and end-user customers. Products are sourced from refiners and transported via rail, barge, truck, and pipeline, requiring extensive logistics and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Distillates (Home Heating Oil, Diesel, Kerosene)
products.description: Distribution and sale of distillates including home heating oil, diesel, and kerosene to wholesale, retail, commercial, and industrial customers. Includes proprietary branded products (Heating Oil Plus™, Diesel One®) and requires blending, storage, and delivery infrastructure.

products.name: Residual Oil and Bunker Fuel
products.description: Sale and custom blending of residual oil and bunker fuel for industrial, commercial, and marine customers, including bunkering services for ships. Requires specialized blending and storage facilities, often at strategic port locations.

products.name: Crude Oil Supply and Logistics
products.description: Purchasing, selling, storing, and transporting domestic and Canadian crude oil via pipeline, rail, and barge for distribution to refiners and other customers. Involves regulated logistics and storage infrastructure.

products.name: Renewable Fuels Distribution
products.description: Distribution and sale of renewable fuels, including ethanol and other biofuels, to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers. Involves blending, storage, and compliance with renewable fuel standards and RIN management.

products.name: Propane Distribution
products.description: Distribution and sale of propane to wholesale and retail customers, primarily through bulk terminals and storage facilities. Requires specialized storage and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Convenience Store Retail (Food, Beverages, Sundries)
products.description: Operation of convenience stores offering food, beverages, snacks, grocery, and non-food merchandise, as well as sundry services such as car wash, lottery, and ATM commissions. Delivered through company-operated and dealer-leased retail locations.

products.name: Gasoline Station Operations and Rental Income
products.description: Operation and leasing of gasoline stations, including direct operation, commissioned agent arrangements, dealer leases, and supply contracts. Revenue includes fuel sales, rental income, and cobranding arrangements. Requires physical retail infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Medical Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of medical office space in owned properties, primarily at the Cortlandt Manor Medical Center and portions of the Flowerfield property. This involves physical real estate management, tenant relations, and compliance with healthcare regulations.

products.name: Industrial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of industrial and warehouse space at the Flowerfield industrial park, including engineering, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities. This is delivered through physical property management and tenant services.

products.name: Real Estate Sales (Land and Developed Properties)
products.description: Sale of owned real estate assets, including developed properties and vacant land, to external buyers such as developers. This involves property marketing, negotiation, and transaction management, often after securing entitlements to enhance value.

products.name: Broadband Internet Services
products.description: Provision of high-speed internet access to residential and commercial customers, primarily using fiber optic and fixed wireless infrastructure, requiring significant physical network deployment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Voice over Internet Protocol (VOIP) Services
products.description: Provision of digital voice communication services delivered over broadband internet connections to residential and business customers, leveraging the company's broadband infrastructure.

products.name: Video Services
products.description: Provision of video content services to customers over broadband networks, utilizing digital delivery methods integrated with the company's internet infrastructure.

products.name: Self-Funded Health Benefits Plans
products.description: Custom-designed health benefits plans for employers, including plan design, network selection, vendor management, and benefits administration, delivered via a digital marketplace and supported by program management services. These plans are tailored for businesses and require integration with third-party administrators and brokers.

products.name: Stop-Loss Insurance Underwriting and Administration
products.description: Underwriting and administrative services for stop-loss insurance policies that protect self-funded employer health plans from large claims, delivered through a web-based SaaS platform (eDIYBS) with AI-enabled rapid quoting and risk assessment. Services include claims monitoring, reinsurance reporting, and bindable quote generation.

products.name: HI Card Healthcare Management Platform
products.description: A digital platform that aggregates and manages medical records, claims, and health plan information for patients, providers, brokers, and TPAs, offering 24/7 access and integration with a proprietary provider network (HI Performance Network) for Medicare-based reimbursement pricing. Delivered as an optional add-on to core services.

products.name: Industrial Water Treatment and Process Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive water treatment chemicals, digital monitoring systems, and process optimization services for industrial customers in sectors such as manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, mining, and petroleum refining. Products are physically manufactured and delivered, often integrated with digital and mechanical components, and supported by field sales and service teams.

products.name: Food and Beverage Cleaning, Sanitation, and Water Solutions
products.description: Cleaning and sanitation chemicals, antimicrobial products, water treatment programs, and application equipment for food and beverage processors, dairy plants, farms, and related industries. Includes direct-contact antimicrobials, clean-in-place systems, and digital dispensing equipment, delivered through both direct sales and distributors.

products.name: Pulp and Paper Water and Process Solutions
products.description: Water treatment chemicals, process aids, and digital monitoring systems for the pulp and paper industry, covering all steps of papermaking and all grades of paper. Includes specialty programs for pulp and paper applications, with products manufactured and delivered to industrial customers.

products.name: Institutional Cleaning, Sanitizing, and Infection Prevention Solutions
products.description: Specialized cleaners, sanitizers, infection prevention products, food safety equipment, and digital dispensing/monitoring systems for hospitality, healthcare, foodservice, lodging, education, and government institutions. Includes warewashing, laundry, housekeeping, and pool/spa treatment programs, with products manufactured and delivered, often supported by on-site service and equipment leasing.

products.name: Specialty Cleaning and Sanitizing Solutions for Foodservice and Retail
products.description: Cleaning and sanitizing chemicals, equipment, and digital platforms tailored for quick service restaurants (QSRs) and food retailers, including hard surface cleaners, degreasers, sanitizers, and dishwashing machine lease programs. Includes training, technical support, and quality assurance services, delivered through direct sales and distributors.

products.name: Pest Elimination Services
products.description: On-site pest detection, prevention, and elimination services for commercial customers in foodservice, hospitality, healthcare, and other sectors. Services are delivered in-person by trained technicians, often using smart, connected devices for monitoring and reporting.

products.name: Life Sciences Cleaning, Contamination Control, and Purification Solutions
products.description: End-to-end cleaning, sanitizing, disinfecting, and contamination control products and systems for pharmaceutical, biopharma, and personal care manufacturers, including detergents, disinfectants, surface wipes, decontamination systems, and purification resins. Products are manufactured and delivered, with some digital and equipment components, and supported by technical expertise.

products.name: Cruise Vacation Packages
products.description: Comprehensive cruise vacation experiences offered under the Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises brands, including accommodations, onboard amenities, entertainment, dining, and transportation to worldwide destinations. These are delivered via a fleet of physically operated ships and require significant capital investment, regulated infrastructure, and in-person hospitality services.

products.name: Onboard Casino Operations
products.description: Casino gaming services provided to guests onboard cruise ships, managed directly by the company and requiring specialized equipment, regulatory compliance, and in-person staff.

products.name: Onboard Food and Beverage Services
products.description: A variety of dining venues, bars, lounges, and specialty dining experiences offered onboard ships, some included in fare and others as premium options, requiring in-person culinary and hospitality staff and physical infrastructure.

products.name: Onboard Spa and Wellness Services
products.description: Spa, wellness, and fitness services provided onboard ships, including full-service spas and wellness programs, delivered by trained staff and sometimes managed through third-party concessionaires.

products.name: Onboard Retail Shopping
products.description: Retail shopping experiences offered onboard ships, including gift shops and boutiques, often managed through third-party concessionaires with the company receiving a percentage of gross sales.

products.name: Shore Excursions
products.description: Curated excursions and activities at ports of call, including adventure, cultural, and sightseeing tours, managed directly or through partners, requiring coordination with local providers and logistics.

products.name: Air Transportation and Hotel Packages
products.description: Bundled air transportation and hotel stays before or after cruises, offered as part of vacation packages, requiring partnerships with airlines and hotels and logistical coordination.

products.name: Private Island Destination Experiences
products.description: Exclusive access to private island destinations such as Great Stirrup Cay (Bahamas) and Harvest Caye (Belize), offering unique amenities, waterparks, and excursions, requiring ownership, development, and operation of physical resort infrastructure.

products.name: Electricity Generation and Distribution
products.description: Generation, purchase, distribution, and sale of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in southeastern Michigan, using a mix of coal, natural gas, nuclear, hydroelectric, wind, solar, and battery storage assets. Delivered via regulated infrastructure and subject to state and federal oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution and Sales
products.description: Purchase, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers throughout Michigan, including the sale of storage and transportation capacity. Delivered via regulated pipeline and storage infrastructure.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas and Environmental Attributes
products.description: Production and sale of renewable natural gas (RNG) from landfill and agricultural methane recovery, including the sale of environmental attributes such as LCFS and RFS credits. RNG is refined to pipeline quality and sold as low carbon transportation fuel.

products.name: Custom Energy Solutions for Industrial and Commercial Customers
products.description: Provision of on-site energy solutions including power generation, steam, chilled water, wastewater treatment, compressed air, and other utility-type services, typically using project assets located on or near customer premises in various industries.

products.name: Metallurgical and Petroleum Coke Supply
products.description: Production and supply of metallurgical coke and pulverized petroleum coke to the steel and other industries, using coke batteries and related infrastructure.

products.name: Wholesale Power and Renewable Energy Sales
products.description: Ownership and operation of renewable generating plants (wind, solar, other) with electric output sold under long-term power purchase agreements to utilities and other buyers.

products.name: Energy Marketing and Trading Services
products.description: Physical and financial marketing and trading of power, natural gas, and environmental products, including structured transactions, risk management, and optimization of contracted pipeline transportation and storage positions. Customers include utilities, pipelines, producers, and other marketers.

products.name: Carbon Capture and Sequestration Services
products.description: Development and operation of carbon capture and sequestration projects for industrial emitters, capturing CO2 and transporting it to underground sequestration sites to help customers meet environmental commitments.

products.name: Industrial Air Quality Solutions
products.description: Engineered systems and equipment for air pollution and contamination control, including emissions management, dust collectors, thermal oxidizers, wet and dry scrubbers, and filtration systems. These are physically manufactured and often customized for industrial facilities to improve air quality and meet regulatory standards.

products.name: Industrial Water and Wastewater Treatment Solutions
products.description: Engineered products and systems for industrial water and wastewater treatment, including water treatment packages, oily water separation, ultra-high purity water treatment, and produced water treatment. These solutions are physically manufactured and installed at customer sites to treat, recycle, or purify water for industrial processes and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Energy Transition and Emissions Control Solutions
products.description: Systems and equipment supporting cleaner energy production and emissions reduction, such as selective catalytic reduction systems, exhaust emissions control, and solutions for hydrogen, renewable natural gas, and other green fuels. These are engineered and manufactured for power generation and hydrocarbon processing facilities.

products.name: Separation and Filtration Equipment
products.description: Engineered separation and filtration products including fluid bed cyclones, separators, coalescers, and process filtration systems. These are manufactured and installed in industrial processes to separate particulates, liquids, or gases and ensure process efficiency and equipment protection.

products.name: Industrial Dampers, Diverters, and Expansion Joints
products.description: Manufactured mechanical components such as dampers, diverters, and expansion joints used in industrial air and fluid handling systems to control flow, pressure, and accommodate thermal expansion. These are installed in power plants, processing facilities, and other industrial sites.

products.name: Fluid Handling Equipment and Pumps
products.description: Manufactured equipment including metallic and non-metallic pumps and fluid handling systems for moving, controlling, and processing liquids in industrial applications. These are installed in customer facilities for process and utility water management.

products.name: Industrial Silencers and Acoustics Management Solutions
products.description: Engineered silencers and acoustics management products designed to reduce noise in industrial environments, including datacenter acoustics management. These are manufactured and installed to meet regulatory and safety requirements.

products.name: Aftermarket Products and Value-Added Services
products.description: Recurring revenue services including aftermarket support, maintenance, spare parts, consumables, and value-added services for installed equipment. These services are delivered through in-person labor and logistics to maintain and optimize customer systems.

products.name: Plant Engineering and Design-Build Fabrication Services
products.description: Engineering, project management, and design-build fabrication services for industrial plants, including duct fabrication and installation. These services involve in-person engineering labor and physical construction at customer sites.

products.name: CLEAR+ Travel Subscription Service
products.description: A consumer travel subscription service providing access to dedicated airport security lanes using biometric identity verification, delivered through physical infrastructure and in-person support at airports nationwide.

products.name: TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Provided by CLEAR
products.description: A service for enrolling and renewing TSA PreCheck® memberships at airports and retail locations, involving in-person identity verification and digital processing, operated under partnership with the TSA.

products.name: CLEAR1 Identity Verification Platform (B2B)
products.description: A business-to-business multi-layered identity verification solution integrating biometric, document, and device signals, delivered via APIs and SDKs for partners in sectors like healthcare, workforce, and government.

products.name: CLEAR Concierge
products.description: A premium, personalized airport service where a dedicated Ambassador provides curbside-to-gate assistance, enhancing the travel experience for high-frequency and premium travelers through in-person support.

products.name: CLEAR Mobile App and Digital Identity Solutions
products.description: A mobile application offering digital identity features such as enrollment, Home to Gate travel planning, e-Passport storage, CLEAR ID for mobile-based TSA checkpoint verification, and touchless access to partner venues, delivered digitally.

products.name: CLEAR Perks and Partner Benefits
products.description: A suite of added benefits and offers for CLEAR+ Members, provided through partnerships with other brands and service providers to enhance the travel experience, delivered digitally or in-person.

products.name: Snapchat Application
products.description: A mobile and web-based visual messaging and content platform offering AR experiences, messaging, Stories, Snap Map, Spotlight, and creative tools. Delivered digitally via app stores and browsers, requiring large-scale cloud infrastructure and ongoing software development.

products.name: Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital advertising products including AR Ads, Snap Ads, Story Ads, Collection Ads, Dynamic Ads, Commercials, Sponsored Snaps, and Promoted Places, delivered through a self-serve platform with advanced targeting and measurement tools. Requires proprietary ad technology and data analytics infrastructure.

products.name: Subscription Services (Snapchat+, Lens+, Snapchat Platinum)
products.description: Paid subscription offerings providing access to exclusive, experimental, and pre-release features, additional AR Lenses, and ad-free experiences. Delivered digitally through the Snapchat platform, leveraging software development and cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Memories Storage Plans
products.description: Cloud-based storage subscriptions allowing users to purchase additional space for saving Snaps and Memories. Delivered digitally via the Snapchat platform, requiring scalable cloud storage infrastructure.

products.name: Spectacles (AR Glasses)
products.description: Wearable augmented reality glasses that overlay digital content onto the real world, powered by Snap OS and designed for developers and creators to build AR experiences. Requires physical manufacturing, hardware engineering, and software integration.

products.name: AR Development Tools (Lens Studio, Camera Kit, Bitmoji for Developers)
products.description: Software tools and APIs enabling developers and creators to build, distribute, and integrate AR Lenses and Bitmoji into Snapchat and third-party apps. Delivered digitally, requiring ongoing software development and support.

products.name: Tower Site Rental Services
products.description: Leasing space or capacity on owned or operated wireless communication towers to tenants, primarily wireless carriers, through long-term contracts. This is a recurring, contract-based service requiring ownership or control of physical tower infrastructure and ongoing property management.

products.name: Tower Site Development Services
products.description: Providing pre-construction site development services for new or existing tenant equipment installations on towers, including site acquisition, architectural and engineering, and zoning and permitting. These are typically non-recurring, project-based services delivered by in-person labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Corrugated Packaging
products.description: Manufacture and conversion of containerboard into corrugated sheets and containers, including protective cartons, retail-ready packaging, and point-of-sale displays, primarily for shipping, storage, and product promotion. Production involves large-scale paper mills and converting plants using both virgin and recycled fiber.

products.name: Consumer Packaging (Folding Cartons, Inserts, Labels)
products.description: Production of paperboard-based folding cartons, inserts, and labels for primary packaging of consumer goods, using advanced printing, coating, and finishing technologies. Delivered as finished, custom-designed packaging for industries such as food, beverages, health and beauty, and pharmaceuticals.

products.name: Bag-in-Box Packaging
products.description: Manufacture of bag-in-box packaging systems, where liquids are packed in flexible plastic bags with taps, typically inserted into corrugated containers. Production includes both bags and taps, serving markets such as wine and other beverages.

products.name: Solidboard and Solidboard Packaging
products.description: Production of solidboard (a layered, moisture-resistant paperboard) and conversion into packaging for demanding applications, such as fresh produce and frozen goods. Manufactured in paper mills and converted in specialized plants.

products.name: Kraft Paper and Paper Sacks
products.description: Manufacture of kraft paper (from virgin wood fiber) and conversion into paper sacks and bags for industrial and retail use, including high-strength sacks for building materials, chemicals, and animal feed, as well as retail carrier bags.

products.name: Graphic Board Products
products.description: Production of heavyweight graphic board, used for applications requiring rigidity and printability, such as book covers, game boards, puzzles, and office supplies. Manufactured in specialized mills and converted for end-use.

products.name: Distribution of Packaging Products
products.description: Distribution of corrugated packaging materials and specialty packaging products (e.g., stretch film, tapes, void fill) through a network of warehouses and distribution facilities, including contract packing and assembly services.

products.name: Market Pulp and Specialty Paper Grades
products.description: Production and sale of market pulp and specialty paper grades not used internally, serving external customers in packaging, food service, liquid packaging, and commercial print markets. Manufactured in integrated virgin and recycled fiber mills.

products.name: CATV Networking Equipment and Components
products.description: A range of fiber-optic networking products for cable television (CATV) networks, including lasers, transmitters, transceivers, amplifiers, nodes, and turn-key equipment. These products are physically manufactured using vertically integrated processes and are sold to CATV equipment vendors and directly to multiple system operators (MSOs).

products.name: Data Center Optical Transceivers and Modules
products.description: High-speed optical transceivers and modules for internet data centers, enabling connectivity between switches and servers over fiber optic cables. These products are manufactured using in-house lasers and subassemblies, with significant automation for high-volume production, and are sold to hyperscale data center operators and equipment suppliers.

products.name: Telecom Optical Components and Transceivers
products.description: Lasers, laser subassemblies, and optical transceivers designed for telecommunications networks, including advanced 5G mobile network deployments and metro-scale telecom networking. These products are manufactured using proprietary laser fabrication processes and are sold to network equipment manufacturers and transceiver manufacturers.

products.name: Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) Optical Modules and Components
products.description: Optical modules and components for passive optical networks (PONs) used in fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) deployments, supporting technologies such as GPON, XGS-PON, WDM-PON, and higher data rate PON networks. These products are physically manufactured and sold to telecom service providers and MSOs.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail real estate properties, including shopping centers, outlet centers, and malls, to a diverse group of tenants such as department stores, grocers, discounters, entertainment venues, restaurants, and service providers. This involves physical ownership, management, and operation of real estate assets.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Development and Redevelopment Services
products.description: Development and redevelopment of retail real estate assets, including expanding properties, redeveloping underutilized space, and developing pad sites. This requires capital investment, construction, and project management expertise.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Asset Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of retail real estate assets for value maximization, including proactive leasing, tenant mix optimization, property improvements, and operational efficiency. Delivered through in-person management and ongoing property oversight.

products.name: Vonoprazan-based Acid Suppression Therapies (VOQUEZNA)
products.description: Oral small molecule potassium-competitive acid blocker (PCAB) therapies, including VOQUEZNA tablets, manufactured using commercial pharmaceutical processes and distributed via wholesalers and pharmacies. Delivered as prescription drugs for the treatment of erosive and non-erosive gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and heartburn in adults.

products.name: Vonoprazan-based Combination Therapies for H. pylori Infection (VOQUEZNA DUAL PAK and VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK)
products.description: Co-packaged oral therapies combining vonoprazan with antibiotics (amoxicillin, with or without clarithromycin), manufactured and packaged by third-party suppliers, and distributed as prescription drugs for the eradication of Helicobacter pylori infection in adults.

products.name: Silicon Carbide Ceramic Membranes for Liquid Filtration
products.description: Manufactures and sells patented silicon carbide ceramic membranes and hybrid technology membranes for liquid purification in industrial, oil & gas, chemical, pool, marine, and other applications. These are physically manufactured, durable, and chemically resistant filtration products delivered as components or integrated into systems.

products.name: Liquid Filtration Systems & Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells turnkey liquid filtration systems incorporating proprietary silicon carbide membrane technology for industrial wastewater, produced water, marine, pool, mining, and other demanding applications. These are engineered, modular systems delivered as complete solutions to customers.

products.name: Diesel Particulate Filters (DPFs) for Gas Purification
products.description: Manufactures and sells silicon carbide diesel particulate filters for exhaust emission control in vehicles, generators, marine, and non-road machinery. These are physically manufactured filters with proprietary catalytic coatings, sold to OEM and retrofit markets worldwide.

products.name: Engineered Plastic Components and Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells engineered plastic parts and products for industrial applications, including the food & beverage and pharmaceutical industries. These are custom-fabricated plastic components produced using machining, welding, bending, and solvent cementing.

products.name: Aftermarket Services and Spare Parts for Filtration Systems
products.description: Provides aftermarket services, maintenance agreements, and spare parts for installed filtration systems, supporting ongoing operation and customer satisfaction. This is a service-based offering leveraging the installed base of filtration systems.

products.name: Office Leasing
products.description: Leasing of modernized, amenitized, and well-located office space in Manhattan, produced and delivered through ownership, management, and operation of office properties.

products.name: Retail Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail space in New York City, delivered through ownership and management of retail properties, including prime assets in key neighborhoods.

products.name: Multifamily Residential Leasing
products.description: Leasing of multifamily residential units, including both market-rate and affordable housing, managed through third-party property managers and subject to government regulation for certain units.

products.name: Empire State Building Observatory Ticket Sales
products.description: Operation and ticket sales for the Empire State Building's 86th and 102nd floor observatories, delivered through on-site visitor experiences and reservation systems.

products.name: Engineered Thermoplastic Compounds and Blends
products.description: Custom rigid and soft thermoplastic compounds and blends, including PC/ABS, ABS compounds, TPEs, and polypropylene compounds, manufactured at global facilities and tailored for high-end applications in automotive, consumer electronics, medical, footwear, and wellness markets. Delivered as pellets or sheets, often to customer specifications, with a focus on sustainable and recycled content.

products.name: Polymethyl Methacrylate (PMMA) Resins and Sheets
products.description: PMMA resins and sheets, produced via continuous-cast, extrusion, and cell-cast processes, supplied for automotive, building & construction, medical, consumer goods, and wellness applications. Includes both virgin and recycled PMMA, with manufacturing and recycling operations in Europe and the US.

products.name: Latex Binders
products.description: A range of latex binder products, including styrene-butadiene (SB) latex, styrene-acrylate (SA) latex, all-acrylic latex, vinylidene chloride latex, and butadiene-methacrylate latex, manufactured for use as binders and adhesives in paper and board coatings, carpet and artificial turf, flooring, and CASE (coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers) applications. Production occurs at facilities in the US, Europe, and Asia.

products.name: Copolymers (ABS and SAN)
products.description: Mass acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (mABS) and styrene-acrylonitrile (SAN) copolymers, produced using proprietary continuous processes, supplied for automotive, construction sheet, appliances, and consumer goods markets. Includes both virgin and recycled copolymers, with production and licensing of technology to other producers.

products.name: Polystyrene (GPPS and HIPS)
products.description: General purpose polystyrene (GPPS) and high impact polystyrene (HIPS), produced for injection molding and thermoforming customers in appliances, packaging, food service disposables, consumer electronics, and building materials. Includes both virgin and recycled polystyrene, with production in North America and Europe.

products.name: Styrene Monomer
products.description: Styrene monomer, produced primarily through the Americas Styrenics joint venture, supplied as a key raw material to external manufacturers of polystyrene, expandable polystyrene, SB latex, ABS resins, unsaturated polyethylene resins, and styrene-butadiene rubber. Production is focused in North America.

products.name: Recycled and Sustainable Plastics Solutions
products.description: Recycled and sustainable plastics, including post-consumer and post-industrial recycled (PCR) polycarbonate, ABS, TPE, PMMA, and chemically recycled MMA, produced through specialized recycling facilities and pilot plants. These materials are supplied for use in high-end applications across automotive, electronics, building, and consumer goods, supporting customers’ sustainability goals.

products.name: Baby & Child Care Products
products.description: Manufactured disposable diapers, training and youth pants, and related products made from natural or synthetic fibers and advanced absorbency technologies, distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Adult Care Products
products.description: Manufactured incontinence care products, including disposable underwear and pads, using advanced absorbency and nonwoven technologies, distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Feminine Care Products
products.description: Manufactured feminine hygiene products such as pads, liners, tampons, and reusable period underwear, using fiber and nonwoven technologies, distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Family Care Products (Tissue and Paper Products)
products.description: Manufactured tissue and paper products for household use, including facial tissue, toilet paper, and paper towels, produced from cellulose fiber and distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Professional Hygiene and Cleaning Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed professional hygiene and cleaning products such as paper towels, tissues, wipes, and related dispensers for commercial and institutional customers, distributed through direct sales and distributors.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of crude oil, natural gas liquids (NGLs), and natural gas from offshore fields in the Gulf of America. This involves physical extraction, processing, and delivery of hydrocarbons to third-party customers via established offshore infrastructure and pipelines.
